name: prop-fountain-spout

slots.subject: The dry centrepiece of an old town fountain, on its own: a short carved stone column on a round stone foot, with a small round stone bowl near the top and a tarnished brass spout with a little gear-shaped finial above it. Stained and weathered. No water at all, completely dry.
slots.camera: Seen from above at the same steep angle as an isometric town map.
slots.composition: The column is centred and fills about nine tenths of the picture's height, with a clear margin on every side.
slots.background: Isolated on plain flat cream paper with no ground, no scenery and no shadow.

notes: Added to the square's empty basin, which did not read as a fountain without it.
